# External Agent Reference

## Purpose

Template for documenting reference information for any external agent.

## Template

For any new agent, document:

1. **Official links** (website, GitHub, docs)
2. **Supported models** (if applicable)
3. **Key features** (MCP, git integration, etc.)
4. **Important notes** (limitations, quirks)

## Template Structure

```markdown
## Official Links

| Resource | URL |
|----------|-----|
| Website | [TODO](url) |
| GitHub | [TODO](url) |
| Docs | [TODO](url) |

## Supported Models

| Provider | Models |
|----------|--------|
| TODO | TODO |
```

## Notes

Use TODO markers for any information that needs verification from official sources.
